note: Behavioural pins (fixture class (c), GUIDE.md): the output of symcrys in the ITC convention, the safety net of the ITC migration (#121, #137). Captured by audit/itc-baseline/capture.run.ts (npm run audit:itc-baseline) from the revision below; regenerate only by re-capture, never edit. One pin per line: what was asked (id) and the answer or the error (value); numbers rounded to 12 decimals.

value.name: Pentagon-tritetrahedron or tetartoid or tetrahedral pentagon-dodecahedron

pyroelectric.description: Spontaneous electric polarization, which changes with temperature: a polar vector p_i.

ferroaxial.description: Ferroaxial (ferro-rotational) order, e.g. a net rotation of structural units about an axis: an axial vector A_i, the axial toroidal moment (Jahn symbol eV).

piezoelectric.description: Electric polarization linear in stress, P_i = d_ijk T_jk: a polar tensor of rank 3, symmetric in j, k.

gyrotropic.description: Optical activity (optical rotation), G = g_ij α_i α_j: the symmetric part of the axial gyration tensor of rank 2.

ferromagnetic.description: Spontaneous magnetization M_s (ferromagnets, ferrimagnets, weak ferromagnets): an axial vector that changes sign under time reversal.

ferrotoroidic.description: Spontaneous toroidal moment T_i (ferrotoroidic order): a polar vector that changes sign under time reversal (Jahn symbol aV); allowed exactly where the magnetoelectric tensor need not be symmetric.

magnetoelectric.description: Linear magnetoelectric effect, P_i = α_ij H_j: an axial tensor of rank 2 that changes sign under time reversal.

piezomagnetic.description: Magnetization linear in stress, M_i = Λ_ijk T_jk: an axial tensor of rank 3, symmetric in j, k, that changes sign under time reversal.
